items.title: The Tasteful Agent: Measuring and Improving Taste in Long-Horizon Tasks
items.summary: Researchers introduce a new framework for evaluating and enhancing an AI agent's 'taste' or aesthetic judgment in complex, multi-step tasks.

items.title: Meta Unveils Major Updates for its AI Agent Muse
items.summary: Meta announces significant new features and capabilities for its Muse AI agent, expanding its functionality and user interaction.

items.title: Meta Launches Tamagotchi-like Wearable for Muse AI Agent
items.summary: Meta introduces a new wearable device designed to interact with its Muse AI agent, offering a Tamagotchi-like experience for users.

items.title: Meta Debuts Camera-Free AI Glasses
items.summary: Meta reveals new AI-powered glasses that operate without a camera, focusing on privacy-preserving augmented reality and AI assistance.

items.title: GAE: Learning a Geometry-Native Latent Space for 3D-Consistent World Generation
items.summary: A new research paper introduces GAE, a method for learning a latent space that enables the generation of 3D-consistent virtual worlds.

items.title: Per-Agent Cost Tracking for Multi-Agent AI on AWS
items.summary: A guide details how to implement effective cost tracking for multi-agent AI systems deployed on Amazon Web Services.

items.title: OpenAI Extends Cyber Access to Ukraine for Civilian Defense
items.summary: OpenAI announces the expansion of its cyber access initiatives to Ukraine, supporting civilian defense efforts with advanced AI capabilities.

items.title: Sam Altman Addresses United Nations Security Council on AI
items.summary: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman delivers remarks at the UN Security Council, discussing the implications and governance of artificial intelligence.

items.title: All-in-One Multilingual Scene Text Recognition with Script-aware Mixture-of-Experts
items.summary: Researchers present a novel approach for robust multilingual scene text recognition that utilizes a script-aware mixture-of-experts model.

items.title: Google Beam Expands with New Regions, Partners, and Customers
items.summary: Google announces the expansion of its Beam service, bringing its advanced AI capabilities to new geographical regions and welcoming more partners and customers.

items.title: Ovis-Embedding: Pushing the Frontiers of Universal Omni-Modal Embeddings
items.summary: A new paper introduces Ovis-Embedding, a significant advancement in creating universal embeddings that can process and represent information across all modalities.

items.title: Two Years of OpenAI Academy Celebrated
items.summary: OpenAI marks the second anniversary of its Academy program, highlighting its impact on AI education and community development.

items.title: Circuit Hypernetworks for Quantum-Augmented Diffusion Language Models
items.summary: This research explores the integration of quantum computing concepts with diffusion language models through circuit hypernetworks to enhance their capabilities.

items.title: JEV-as-a-Judge: Accept When Confident, Escalate When Unsure
items.summary: Researchers propose JEV-as-a-Judge, an AI system designed to make decisions by accepting confident outputs and escalating uncertain ones for human review.

items.title: StableVQ: Practical Guidelines for Stable Vector-Quantized Tokenizer Training
items.summary: A new paper provides practical guidelines and insights for achieving stable training of vector-quantized tokenizers, crucial for efficient AI models.
